name: Pistols and revolvers
subtitle: Sidearms
summary: Each protagonist has a signature sidearm; the Ultimate Edition adds Vice City-styled revolvers and personalised variants.

facts.text: Pistols were among the weapons shown in the Extended Look.
Ultimate Edition reportedly includes Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers with Vice City styling and personalised variants of the protagonists' sidearms.

name: Rifles
subtitle: Automatic weapons
summary: Automatic rifles feature in the firefights shown so far, used from cover and from moving vehicles.

facts.text: Automatic rifles were shown alongside pistols and shotguns.

name: Shotguns
subtitle: One-handed when it counts
summary: Shotguns return, with a new trick: they can be fired one-handed while your other hand is busy.

facts.text: One-handed shotgun use while holding another item was shown in the Extended Look.

name: Melee and improvised weapons
subtitle: Fists, blades and heels
summary: Hand-to-hand combat has dodges and brutal finishers, and improvised weapons include a stiletto heel.

facts.text: Improved dodging and melee finishing moves were shown.
High heels used as a stabbing weapon, and fist-fighting when disarmed, were shown.

name: Weapon patterns and skins
subtitle: Cosmetics
summary: Weapons can carry patterns; the pre-order pack's tropical design is the first one confirmed.

facts.text: The Vintage Vice City Pack reportedly includes a tropical weapon pattern (a nod to Tommy Vercetti's palm-tree shirt) that applies to most guns.
